evidence.title: AlignUI Design System - Design and development perfectly aligned

name: AlignUI Pro
summary: React and Tailwind UI kit with 100+ components, landing-page blocks and sector templates, plus a synced Figma file.
description: A paid component library built for React and styled with Tailwind CSS. It ships 100+ customizable components and blocks — accordion, announcement, auth card, command menu, data table, datepicker, drawer, dropdown, modal, navbar, pricing, stats, testimonials and more — plus sector-specific multi-page templates (AI, HR management, finance & banking). A Figma library is kept in sync with the code.
contains: 100+ pre-built React components and UI blocks styled with Tailwind CSS
blocks for accordion, auth card, breadcrumbs, command menu, CTA, datepicker, drawer, footer, hero, modal, navbar
sector templates: AI, HR management, finance & banking
Figma file synced with the code library
one-time payment, lifetime access, unlimited projects
Personal, Startups (5 seats) and Enterprise licenses
